rows.note: Use this as the everyday general term when referring collectively to the letters used in a language.

example.english: There are twenty-six letters in the English alphabet.
example.jyutping: jing1 man4 jau5 ji6 sap6 luk6 go3 zi6 mou5

rows.note: Use this when you mean the complete alphabet as an ordered or defined set, especially in explicit explanations or writing.

example.english: The teacher asked us to arrange the words in the order of the alphabet.
example.traditional: 老師叫我哋按字母表嘅次序排啲字。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 on3 zi6 mou5 biu2 ge3 ci3 zeoi6 paai4 di1 zi6
